standard-dialogue.npc: Greetings! I am Hassan, Chancellor to the Emir of Al Kharid.

options.text: Is there anything I can help you with?
It's just too hot here. How can you stand it?

steps.player: It's just too hot here. How can you stand it?

steps.npc: We manage, in our humble way. We are a wealthy town and we have water. It cures many thirsts.

steps.text: The chancellor hands you some water.

options.text: Do you mind if I just kill your warriors?

steps.player: Do you mind if I just kill your warriors?

steps.npc: Kill our warriors? I assume this is some sort of joke?

steps.player: I'll take that as a no. Forget I asked.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-princ.npc: Thank you for being a friend to Al Kharid. You are always welcome here.

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-climb-th.text: If the player has not completed Prince Ali Rescue:

steps.speaker: Hassan
steps.text: Hey, do not treat the Emir's palace like a climbing frame for children, whoever you are!

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-climb-th.text: If the player has completed Prince Ali Rescue:

steps.speaker: Hassan
steps.text: Hey, while you have our gratitude for saving the prince, you must earn our trust more fully before the Emir will tolerate you climbing through his windows like a thief!

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-climb-th.text: You need to complete the hard tier of the Desert achievement diary and get an Agility level of 70 to use this shortcut.

historical-dialogue-prior-to-27-april-20.speaker: Hassan
historical-dialogue-prior-to-27-april-20.text: Greetings I am Hassan, Chancellor to the Emir of Al- Kharid.

options.text: Can I help you? You must need some help here in the desert.
It's just too hot here. How can you stand it?

steps.speaker: Hassan
steps.text: We manage, in our humble way. We are a wealthy town and we have water. It cures many thirsts.
The chancellor hands you some water.

options.text: Do you mind if I just kill your warriors?

steps.speaker: Hassan
steps.text: You are welcome. They are not expensive. We have them here to stop the elite guard being bothered. They are a little harder to kill.

historical-dialogue-prior-to-27-april-20.speaker: Hassan
historical-dialogue-prior-to-27-april-20.text: You are a friend of the town of Al-Kharid. If we have more tasks to complete, we will ask you. Please, keep in contact. Good employees are not easy to find.
